title: Director, Finance Business Operations
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

We are searching for our new Director, Business Operations or Director, Finance & Administration, Financial Services Division reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO). The Director, Business Operations serves as the CFO’s principal operational and administrative partner, with responsibility for leading and integrating the Finance Division’s budget management, personnel actions, and core business services. This role provides division-wide financial and administrative leadership, ensuring sound stewardship of resources, compliance with institutional policies, and the effectiveness of internal controls. The Director functions as the operational anchor for the Finance Division—coordinating execution across finance, human resources, procurement, payroll, and related administrative functions—enabling the CFO to focus on institutional strategy, governance, and external engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management and Budget Oversight

  • Lead the development, coordination, monitoring, and execution of the Finance Division’s annual and multi-year operating budgets, including forecasting, scenario analysis, and budget-to-actual reporting.
  • Serve as the division’s primary resource for financial analysis, management reporting, and projections, translating complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for the CFO and division leadership.
  • Establish and maintain disciplined processes for ongoing monitoring of expenditures, commitments, and revenues, supporting informed decision‑making and proactive financial management.
  • Coordinate and monitor response on all audit findings, assessment recommendations, and corrective action plans for the Finance Division on behalf of the CFO.
  • In collaboration with the Senior Associate Vice President for Financial Strategy, serve as Finance Division liaison to the Risk Management Office and Internal Audit Office.

Business Operations and Administrative Services

  • Oversee and integrate core business services for the Finance Division, including purchasing, accounts payable and receivable, travel and expense reimbursement, contracts routing, and interfaces with risk management.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the Finance Division and central administrative offices (e.g., Budget Office, Controller, Procurement, Payroll, Human Resources, Risk Management), ensuring timely issue resolution and consistent application of policies.
  • Ensure the design, implementation, and monitoring of effective internal controls and compliance practices consistent with institutional, state, and federal guidelines.

Personnel and Human Resources Coordination

  • Lead and coordinate personnel actions for the Finance Division, including position management, hiring, reclassifications, compensation actions, performance management, and separations, in close partnership with Human Resources.
  • Advise managers and senior leaders on staffing strategies, workforce planning, and the budgetary implications of personnel decisions.
  • Directly supervise assigned administrative and financial staff; set priorities, allocate work, evaluate performance, and support professional development and succession planning.

Process Improvement and Operational Effectiveness

  • Identify opportunities to improve financial and administrative processes, systems, technology, and workflows to enhance efficiency, strengthen controls, and improve service delivery across the Finance Division.
  • Lead or support initiatives to streamline operations, standardize practices, and strengthen coordination among finance and administrative units.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and service orientation within the division.

Policy, Planning, and Advisory Role

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the CFO on operational, financial, and administrative implications of division and institutional initiatives.
  • Participate as a member of the Finance Division’s leadership team, contributing to strategic planning, priority setting, and alignment across the division.
  • Contribute to the development, interpretation, and implementation of financial and administrative policies, procedures, and guidelines.
  • Represent the Finance Division on institutional committees, working groups, and initiatives related to finance, administration, and resource stewardship.

Delegated Authority and Accountability

  • Acts on behalf of the CFO for designated financial, budgetary, and administrative approvals, consistent with established delegations of authority.
  • Serves as the CFO’s designee for division‑level operational decisions, ensuring timely execution and adherence to policy.
  • Holds primary accountability for the effective execution of Finance Division operations, escalating strategic or high‑risk issues to the CFO as appropriate.

Scope and Complexity

The Director, Finance Operations operates with a high degree of independence and judgment in support of a complex, multi-functional Finance Division. The role requires balancing operational execution with strategic awareness, managing competing priorities, and coordinating across multiple functional areas. Comparable roles at peer institutions are typically involved in strategic planning, policy development, and serving as key members of the division head’s management team.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, accounting, public administration, or a related field.
  • Substantial (7-10 years) progressively responsible experience in financial management, business operations, and administrative leadership, preferably in higher education or a comparably complex organization.
  • Demonstrated expertise in budgeting, financial analysis, accounting principles, and internal controls.
  • Experience coordinating and overseeing personnel actions in partnership with human resources.
  • Strong leadership, analytical, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to work effectively across functional boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MPA, or related field).
  • Experience supporting or partnering closely with a CFO, vice president, or cabinet‑level leader.
  • Familiarity with higher education financial systems, shared governance environments, and public accountability requirements.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $160,000 - $165,000

title: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience
description:
Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience

Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing.

We are looking for a Pricing & Payments Manager to lead the Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role owns the end-to-end strategy and execution of partner pricing models, incentive programs, payment accuracy, and dispute resolution across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large).

As a People Manager, you will lead and develop a team of specialists, set the strategic direction for pricing and payment mechanisms, build scalable processes, and drive cross‑functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to ensure partner economics are competitive, accurate, and sustainable.

This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel.

If you are passionate about partner economics, operational excellence, and building high‑performing teams, you should join our team.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes specialists, fostering a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement
  • Own the end‑to‑end pricing strategy for logistics partners across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL programs, ensuring competitive and sustainable rate structures
  • Design, implement, and optimize incentive programs that drive partner performance, network efficiency, and cost effectiveness
  • Oversee the payment lifecycle — from invoice validation and payment accuracy to dispute identification, root‑cause analysis, and resolution
  • Build and maintain scalable mechanisms for pricing governance, incentive tracking, payment reconciliation, and dispute management
  • Develop structured reporting and dashboards to monitor pricing competitiveness, incentive ROI, payment accuracy, and dispute aging/resolution rates
  • Partner cross‑functionally with Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to align pricing models with business objectives and contractual frameworks
  • Identify and drive automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention in payment and dispute processes
  • Conduct periodic pricing benchmarking and market analysis to ensure Amazon's partner economics remain competitive
  • Manage escalations related to partner payments and disputes, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder alignment
  • Define and track KPIs for the team, establishing clear goals, performance standards, and development plans for direct reports

A day in the life

Your day starts with metrics review and the team's priorities. Your focus centers on strategic decisions that shape partner economics across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL. You lead cross‑functional negotiations with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to align pricing models with business objectives. You assess incentive program ROI, recommending adjustments to optimize cost efficiency and partner performance. You review payment accuracy dashboards, identifying systemic gaps and designing scalable mechanisms to address them. Between meetings, you coach your team on stakeholder influence and data‑driven storytelling. Every day balances strategic thinking, cross‑functional alignment, and talent development to drive sustainable partner economics at scale.

About the team

The Pricing & Payments team is part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP, AMXL, and AMPL programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate under competitive, transparent, and accurate pricing and payment frameworks, while driving performance through well‑designed incentive programs and efficient dispute resolution. We build scalable pricing models, payment governance mechanisms, and incentive strategies that balance cost efficiency with partner sustainability. The team sits within a broader strategic structure that also covers Compliance & Communications, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross‑functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering
  • Speak, write, and read fluent in English
  • Experience managing and developing high‑performance teams
  • Experience conducting sophisticated and creative analysis of complex data and translating results into actionable deliverables, messages, and presentations
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development, legal, etc.
  • Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment
  • Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English
  • Experience in deal management and pricing strategy, or financial consulting

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA, or Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
  • Experience using SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
  • Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques
  • Experience in logistics
  • Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers
  • Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis, or experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
  • Experience designing incentive programs or performance‑based compensation structures
  • Experience building payment reconciliation or dispute management mechanisms at scale

title: Maintenance Engineer
description:
Job Function:

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver powerful solutions.

We are currently seeking a skilled and dedicated Maintenance Engineer to join our Offshore Production Operating Division, based in Rio de Janeiro. This role is a critical part of our Onshore Operations Support team and plays a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and efficiency of offshore production assets. As a Maintenance Engineer, you will be instrumental in supporting the maintenance strategies and activities that help maintain continuous and safe operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, review, and implement maintenance plans, schedules, and procedures for offshore production equipment and systems to maximise operational availability.
  • Coordinate and supervise maintenance activities, ensuring adherence to safety, quality, and environmental standards.
  • Perform technical analysis and troubleshooting to diagnose equipment failures and implement corrective actions promptly.
  • Collaborate closely with operations teams, suppliers, and contractors to plan and execute maintenance work efficiently and effectively.
  • Contribute to the improvement of maintenance processes and system reliability through data analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and health, safety and environmental (HSE) standards during all maintenance operations.
  • Support the preparation of maintenance reports, documentation, and compliance records for internal and external audits.
  • Participate in risk assessments and contribute to the development of maintenance‑related safety procedures and emergency response plans.

Qualifications & Experience

  • A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Marine Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Proven experience in maintenance engineering, preferably within the offshore oil and gas or marine production industries.
  • Strong understanding of offshore production equipment, mechanical, electrical and instrumentation systems.
  • Familiarity with maintenance management systems (CMMS) and relevant software tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver maintenance projects within agreed deadlines.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills combined with strong communication abilities and teamwork orientation.
  • Knowledge of international safety standards and regulatory requirements applicable to offshore operations.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work in a dynamic and supportive international offshore production environment.
  • Engagement with cutting‑edge technologies and innovative maintenance practices.
  • Collaborative team culture focused on safety, inclusion, and professional development.
  • Competitive remuneration package and benefits aligned with experience and qualifications.

If you are passionate about maintenance engineering and committed to operational excellence in offshore production, we encourage you to join our team.

If you want to team up with us as we dream and stride towards a better tomorrow – we would love to hear from you!

title: Fleet Services Manager
description:
Fleet Services Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

The Position

The Fleet Service Manager will oversee the efficient and effective operation of the Tournament fleet and any ancillary event. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of fleet services and operations, working close to the other Transport workstreams providing a reliable, on-time and outstanding service for the established FIFA Client Groups, such as PMAs, Referees, VVIP, FIFA Delegates, FIFA Workforce and Arrivals and Departures. The Fleet Services and Operations Manager will play a crucial role in optimizing fleet performance, developing and ensuring compliance of Service Level Agreements, Policies and Procedures, Operational Plan and Reports. This role reports to the Senior Transport Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary liaison between the Transport FA and FIFA/LFS departments for all fleet-related planning and operational matters for FWWC2027 and any ancillary event.
  • Act as the primary operational interface between FIFA Transport and the VIK vehicle provider (Hyundai/Kia), ensuring full alignment on vehicle specifications, delivery timelines, service levels, and operational needs.
  • Coordinate the reception, inspection, and acceptance of VIK vehicles, ensuring all units meet quality and operational readiness criteria before deployment. Manage the return, decommissioning, and handback process of VIK vehicles post-tournament, including damage reporting, documentation, and reconciliation with the provider.
  • Act as the primary operational interface with Vehicle and drivers’ suppliers ensuring service has been delivered as per contract. Monitor Fleet services performance against agreed KPIs, escalating issues and implementing corrective actions when service levels are not met.
  • Manage all ancillary contracts and operational processes related to the fleet, including vehicle washing and cleaning, refueling services, toll management, and the handling of traffic fines.
  • Develop the fleet depot Concept of Operations (including the fleet design) and ensure its implementation across all Host Cities. Coordinate with all Host Cities depot locations, space, utilities, and facility requirements to confirm requirements are fully met.
  • Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees relating to all Fleet Operations.
  • Act as the central coordinator for the development of Fleet Policies & Procedures, reports, presentations and Guidelines.

We offer a generous relocation package to support a smooth transition to living and working in Bangkok.

The B2B Marketing team at Agoda is seeking a Marketing Strategy Analyst (B2B Content Strategy) to work on our content strategy efforts. The ideal candidate will define and execute our product marketing strategy, ensure our products resonate with our target audience, and drive market success. You will work on initiatives to enhance our brand visibility and create compelling narratives for our B2B partners and prospective partners.

Role Overview

As the Marketing Strategy Analyst (B2B Content Strategy) , you will develop and execute communication strategies aimed at B2B partners. This role contributes to Agoda’s product marketing strategies, core value propositions, content optimization, measurement tracking, and materials for C-suite presentations. You will collaborate with stakeholders across departments to showcase our strengths in the B2B travel sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and Implement Product Marketing Strategy: create strategies and materials that engage B2B audiences, elevate brand awareness, and deliver measurable business results across multiple business units.
  • Craft Compelling Product Messaging: develop messaging and positioning that differentiates our products in the market.
  • Project Management of Cross-Functional Initiatives: ensure alignment and effective communication among stakeholders while managing cross-functional projects.
  • Performance Analysis: analyze product and channel metrics to refine marketing strategies and improve offerings.
  • Enhance Sales Materials and Strategy: design and execute go-to-market plans for product launches, including promotional campaigns, sales enablement, and training.
  • Conduct Market Research: identify partner needs and market trends to develop competitive positioning.
  • Craft Engaging Presentations: design and manage high-impact presentations for partners and C-suite executives.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Extensive Experience: at least 2 years in product marketing, strategy, content marketing, or related roles, preferably in tech. B2B marketing experience is a plus.
  • Data-Driven Approach: strong analytical skills; ability to translate data into actionable insights (SQL knowledge is a plus).
  • Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: ability to tackle complex challenges and adapt to evolving scenarios.
  • Strong Communication Skills: excellent writing and verbal communication; ability to create impactful presentations.
  • Strategic Mindset: experience in developing content that aligns with business objectives and enhances brand narrative.
  • Industry and Product Knowledge: familiarity with tech and travel industries; online travel agency experience is a plus.
  • Technical Proficiency: knowledge of marketing automation tools, CRM systems, and analytics software is advantageous.

Why Join Us?

At Agoda, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our communication strategies and driving growth within the B2B marketing division. If you are an innovative thinker passionate about travel technology and have the skills to elevate our brand narrative, we invite you to apply and be part of our dynamic team.

Senior Revenue Manager (Job Number: HOT0CJA6)

Work Locations

Hilton Copacabana Rio de Janeiro Av. Atlântica, 1020 - Copacabana Rio de Janeiro

This position will report to the Commercial Director and will be the main responsible for the Revenue strategy of the assigned hotel, lead Commercial Strategy Meetings, conduct special projects as assigned, managing rooms inventory, rates and Revenue Management systems to maximize Total Revenue and Market Share, forecasting, budgeting, business planning, the preparation of month end and ad-hoc analysis and the communication of rates, restrictions and strategies to the assigned property.

The individual holding this position will deputise the department in absence of the Commercial Director, and is responsible for team supervision and training, including but not limited to Cluster Revenue Analyst and Reservations Supervisor.

What will I be doing?

  • Defining overall Revenue strategy for the assigned hotel, including all business segments as well as other Revenue driven Departments
  • Exploring Business Opportunities that drive profit, create value for clients, and encourage innovation; challenging existing processes/systems/products to make improvements
  • Providing Revenue Management functional expertise to property Area Brazil General Manager and Leadership teams
  • Making Decisions and Solving Problems - Analysing information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems
  • Communicating Information Timely - Informing and/or updating the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner
  • Completing weekly, monthly and full year forecasts as well as budgets and business plans
  • Analysing all available systems data to identify trends, future need periods and obstacles to achieving goals
  • Outline risks and opportunities relative to Revenue forecasts
  • Implementation of Revenue Management action plan in a timely manner
  • Generating and Delivering Accurate and Timely Results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.
  • Ensuring that restrictions, rates and strategies are modified as market conditions fluctuate
  • Preparation of the agenda and conducting Commercial strategy meetings
  • Monitoring the compliance in terms of distribution
  • Checking distribution channels for hotel positioning, information accuracy and competitor positioning, exploring opportunities in partnership with Marketing
  • Adopting new Revenue Management systems and tools to drive revenue and profit opportunities
  • Deputise the department in absence of the Cluster DRM
  • Manage and lead the Revenue and Reservations’ Team, as well as strategically guide the assigned Department to achieve Team and organisational goals
  • Ensure Team Members have current knowledge for all relevant processes, policies and promotions, as necessary, to perform their duties
  • Recruit, manage, train and develop the Revenue and Reservations’ Team

What are we looking for?

  • Min 4 years’ experience in Revenue Management on managerial level, preferably with Intl. brands
  • Degree level qualification in a relevant field (Business Administration, Finance, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Marketing, Hospitality)
  • Revenue Management - Domain of revenue management area, processes and strategies. Skill in using Revenue Management systems and interpreting pricing and inventory reports

  • Economics and Finance - Knowledge of economic principles and practices, P&L statements, operating budgets, forecasting and scheduling, and the reporting of financial data

  • Adaptability - Maintains performance level under pressure or when experiencing changes or challenges in the workplace
  • Communication - Conveys information and ideas to others in a convincing and engaging manner through a variety of methods
  • Coworker Relationships - Interacts with others in a way that builds openness, trust, and confidence in the pursuit of organisational goals and lasting relationships
  • Problem Solving and Decision Making - Identifies and understands issues, problems, and opportunities; obtains and compares information from different sources to draw conclusions, develop and evaluate alternatives and solutions, solve problems, and choose a course of action
  • Professional Demeanour - Exhibits behavioural styles that convey confidence and command respect from others; makes a good first impression and represents the company in alignment with its values
  • Building and Contributing to Teams - Actively participates as a member of a team to move the team toward the completion of goals
  • Driving for Results - Sets high standards of performance for self-and/or others; assumes responsibility for work objectives; initiates, focuses, and monitors the efforts of self-and/or others toward the accomplishment goals; proactively takes action and goes beyond what is required
  • Organisational Capability - Evaluates and adapts the structure of own assignments and suggests improvements to work processes to best fit the needs and/or support the goals of an organisational unit
  • Talent Management - Provides support and feedback to help individuals develop and strengthen skills and abilities needed to accomplish work objectives
  • Computer and Systems Skills: Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, Power BI, Hilton Systems preferred (GRO, OnQ R&I, OPERA, Delphi)
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese

What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For more than a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • ETL Data Engineering: Develop and maintain ETL data engineering processes using Python (PySpark) within Azure Synapse Analytics Notebooks, and/or Azure Synapse Analytics Pipelines, to ensure efficient data extractions, transformation, and loading.
  • Data Warehousing: Apply your expertise in data warehousing, understanding star schemas, facts, and dimensions, to design and build effective data storage structures in a Massively Parallel Processing (MPP) SWL Pool.
  • Data Source Expertise: Extract data from various sources, including REST APIs, SWL database tables, and CSV files.
  • Azure Synapse Analytics Expertise: Utilize your deep knowledge of Azure Synapse Analytics to design and optimize data notebooks/pipelines for scalability and performance.
  • Data Fabric Concepts: Contribute to the implementation and understanding of other Data Fabric concepts, such as data lakes, lakehouses, delta lakes, and data cataloging, to enhance data management capabilities.
  • Data Modeling: Collaborate with data architects to create data models and schemas that align with business requirements.
  • Data Quality: Implement data quality checks and validation processes to maintain data accuracy and consistency.
  • Performance Tuning: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and optimize ETL data notebooks/pipelines to meet SLAs.
  • Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Monitoring ETL jobs, diagnose issues, and implement solutions to ensure data pipeline reliability.
  • Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of ETL data engineering processes, data flows, and data transformations.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and provide support for data-related initiatives.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure data security and compliance with data governance and privacy standards.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent work experience, with certifications related to data engineering or data science (e.g. Azure Data Engineer) being a plus.
  • Proven experience in ETL data engineering with significant expertise in using Python (PySpark) to perform data extraction, transformation, and loading from REST APIs, SQL database tables, and CSV files.
  • Proficiency in using Azure Synapse Analytics resources including Notebooks, Pipelines, Linked Services, and Azure Key Vault.
  • Demonstrated ability to write complex SQL queries, optimize query performance, and work with both SparkSQL and MS SQL to effectively extract, transform, and load data.
  • Knowledge of data integration best practices and tools.
  • Experience with version control systems, such as Git (Azure DevOps).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a keen attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with shifting priorities.
  • Familiarity with big data technologies, machine learning, and data analysis preferred.
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) and Agile Methodologies a plus.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid‑time‑off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

title: Especialista em Ciência de Dados
description:
Especialista em Ciência de Dados (Base em SP, RJ ou BH)

Job type: Full-time employee

Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Soluções para a Prática Médica para trabalhar de forma remota.

Ao assumir o cargo de Especialista em Ciência de Dados na Afya, seu objetivo principal será liderar o desenvolvimento e a arquitetura de soluções avançadas de Machine Learning e GenAI, impulsionando decisões estratégicas e a evolução dos produtos digitais da companhia.

Você atuará na área de Ciência de Dados dentro da diretoria de Tecnologia.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

  • Liderar tecnicamente e arquitetar soluções de ponta-a-ponta em Machine Learning para os produtos digitais da Afya.
  • Definir e conduzir a estratégia de experimentação e análise estatística avançada para otimizar o engajamento, retenção e o impacto das alterações nos produtos.
  • Atuar como referência (SME) em GenAI, com foco exclusivo no fluxo de avaliações (evaluation), construção de Small Language Models (SLMs) e Fine-Tuning , garantindo respostas seguras e alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Influenciar o roadmap de produto e de outras squads (AIOps, AI Engineer) através da identificação de oportunidades baseadas em dados e da prototipação de novas soluções de IA.
  • Estabelecer e disseminar boas práticas de código (Python) garantindo a qualidade e a performance dos modelos em produção.
  • Mentorar outros cientistas de dados (Jr, Pleno, Sênior) em desafios técnicos complexos.
  • Comunicar e defender arquiteturas, decisões técnicas e resultados de modelos complexos para stakeholders técnicos e executivos.

O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Pós-graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência avançada e comprovada em Python e suas principais bibliotecas (ex: Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Conhecimento profundo em estatística, design de experimentos (Testes A/B) e inferência causal.
  • Vasta experiência com técnicas tradicionais de Machine Learning (Classificação, Regressão, Clusterização, Séries Temporais) e conhecimento de Deep Learning.
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento, fine-tuning e produção de soluções com IA Generativa (foco em LLMs/SLMs).
  • Domínio do ciclo de vida completo de Data Science (MLOps/LLMOps), incluindo arquitetura, evaluation, monitoramento e observabilidade de modelos.
  • Experiência na definição e implementação de Feature Stores , incluindo melhores práticas de governança, versionamento e disponibilização de features.
  • Experiência prática com MLFlow para orquestração e versionamento de modelos.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento (Git) e familiaridade com práticas de CI/CD.
  • Inglês avançado (necessário para leitura de artigos científicos e comunicação técnica).
  • Experiência prática com a plataforma Databricks.
  • Experiência com processamento distribuído (Spark).

GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time.

Confira os principais abaixo:

Para o dia a dia:

  • Vale-alimentação / refeição;
  • Flexibilidade de horários e alocações (para vagas Remotas);
  • Vale-transporte (para vagas Hibridas ou Presenciais);

UP na remuneração:

  • Multibenefícios: Benefício flexível via Cartão Flash para usar como preferir.
  • Gympass / Wellhub;
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);
  • Rede D'Ór: suporte e informações importantes para a saúde da mamãe e do bebê com uma rede credenciada de enfermeiros;
  • Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência);
  • Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário).

Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado:

  • Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA);
  • Programa de desenvolvimento para líderes;
  • Mentoria para Mulheres da Afya (MMA);
  • Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades de ensino da Afya.

Diferencial para Professor Médico:

  • Step 4: Etapa Atração 4 Etapa Atração

Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde em conjunto com quem tem a medicina como vocação. Se você se identifica com o jeito Afya de ser, vem com a gente transformar a saúde com educação e tecnologia.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff «for fit» makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

As a key member of The Emancipator’s editorial team, the Breaking News Correspondent is an integral part of the news organization’s daily news coverage ensuring we «stay in the conversation» with mission-focused content that is sharp, timely, relevant, fast, deftly researched and vetted, and well reported and written. The Breaking News Correspondent nimbly reports, writes, and web produces timely news stories, essays, scripts, and social posts. This position offers early-career journalists an opportunity to build their reporting muscles in a fast-paced, mission-driven newsroom with hands‑on mentorship and clear growth pathways. You’ll learn to strengthen reporting, writing, and publishing regularly in a collaborative newsroom where editors provide active feedback and development. This position is funded by a one‑year grant, with the possibility of renewal. The Breaking News Correspondent reports directly to the Managing Editor.

Supervisory Authority

While this role has no direct supervisory authority, the Breaking News Correspondent may be asked to help mentor student interns and/or student employees. This role may be asked to serve as lead on projects related to helping promote The Emancipator’s editorial mission and goals.

Nature And Scope

This position will interact with faculty, staff, students, and internal and external contacts.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Collaborate with The Emancipator team on editorial matters
  • Ensure the confidentiality and preservation of sensitive information
  • Adhere to newsroom operational structure and editorial workflows
  • Attend newsroom meetings and events as well as those conducted by HIAS more broadly where required and as needed
  • Utilize editorial support services such as webpage hosting, photos, videos, Slack, and social media

Editorial

  • Serve as a collegial, professional, and efficient newsroom presence
  • Support the strategic editorial coverage plan and execution
  • Adhere to the publishing calendar and cadence
  • Pitch timely, relevant, mission-aligned content
  • Report, write, and web produce stories, essays, scripts, social posts

Collaboration And Communication

  • Collaborate with team members and contribute to group projects
  • Support fellow reporters, producers, and freelancers by offering feedback and guidance
  • Help maintain a collegial and professional newsroom environment
  • Coordinate with other departments or external partners when necessary and directed
  • Communicate collegially, clearly and effectively, both in writing and verbally

Professional Development And Media Appearances

  • Collaborate with the Editor-In-Chief and Managing Editor on the pursuit of and attendance at professional development opportunities such as conferences, lectures, and speaking engagements
  • Collaborate with the Editor-In-Chief and Managing Editor and, where applicable, Howard University public relations office, on media appearances and statements

Core Competencies

Technical Proficiency

  • Highly skilled in reporting and writing
  • Proficient in CMS, news analytics tools, social media platforms, video and photo databases
  • Skilled in navigating government, public records, and archival databases

Attention To Detail

  • Sharp and highly experienced news judgment
  • Meticulous in handling and publishing editorial content

    Organizational Skills

    • Effectively manage time to meet project deadlines
    • Handle multiple tasks and adjust priorities based on project needs

    Analytical Thinking

    • Offer solutions to editorial and organizational challenges
    • Adhere to newsroom best practices

    Communication Skills

    • Clear and effective written and verbal communication
    • Provide instructions and feedback to students or junior staff

    Collaborative Skills

    • Work well within a team and contribute to group projects
    • Ability to «manage up» with higher level leadership

    Adaptability

    • Flexibly adapt to new technologies and methods.
    • Continuously learn and seek professional development
    • Handle multiple tasks and adjust priorities as needed

    Project Management

    • Oversee content from inception to completion
    • Track progress and report on outcomes

    Minimum Requirements

    • Based in the Washington D.C. metro area.
    • Education: Bachelor’s Degree or higher in journalism
    • Minimum one year of journalism experience (including internships, on campus publications, and/or freelance work)
    • Demonstrated reporting on race and justice editorial content
    • Demonstrated ability to participate on teams of varied sizes–including those that include freelancers/contributors
    • Demonstrated experience in directly producing breaking news content
    • Knowledge of digital publishing protocols and analytics
    • Experience with CMS and digital editing software
    • Strong attention to detail and organization accuracy with recordkeeping
    • Troubleshooting and problem solving expertise
    • Demonstrated initiative to work self‑directed yet with a collaborative style
    • Strong verbal and written communications skills

description:
Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!

O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação

title: Communications Technician
description:
Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators.

Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the‑art Satellite fleet consists of 14 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat‑1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit

Reporting to the Manager, Satellite Operations, the Communications Technician performs real time Telemetry, Track and Control (TTC) of all satellites operated by Telesat Brazil and monitors ground systems according to established procedures and policies; is responsible for all aspects of successful in‑orbit mission operations; serves as an interface to internal and external customers, as it relates to the daily transponder accesses; and is responsible for the overall ground station or facilities operations.

Responsibilities

Satellite In-Orbit Operations

  • Monitor all in-orbit satellite performance.
  • Provide routine operations to maintain the satellite orbit and subsystems health.
  • Provide emergency system operations in accordance with contingency plans;
  • Respond immediately to all anomalous events and/or alarms;
  • Prepare anomaly reports to engineers for further investigation;
  • Operate, configure and monitor satellite subsystems, including: Power, Thermal, Reaction Control, Attitude, TT&C, and Communications;
  • Perform station keeping maneuvers, battery reconditioning, eclipse operations, and other routine operations;
  • Maintain and operate ground station TT&C equipment: Antenna Control Units, Command, Ranging and Telemetry racks, and Command Encryption modules;
  • Maintain and operate front-end processors and associated computers;
  • Conduct special satellite testing as directed by satellite engineering/management.

Customer Service Operations

  • Answer incoming calls from Uplinkers, Customers, and persons requesting information.
  • Perform Uplinker performance checks and transponder-access tests, including Transponder frequency, Polarization, Deviation, and Power.
  • Correlate power/polarization level adjustments with field technicians.
  • Monitor consoles, maintain event logs, and enter information into databases.
  • Perform troubleshooting of reported video and audio troubles using appropriate test equipment.
  • Identify and elevate service outages and abnormal conditions.
  • Assist other technicians during busy times and provide relief during breaks and lunch periods.
  • Respond to all customer trouble calls and inquiries - initiate, review, update, and clear trouble tickets.
  • Coordinate customer booking problems and transponder service extensions with Telesat Engineering.
  • Perform satellite and transponder restorations as directed by the restoration plans.
  • Assist Engineering and customer Field Engineers as requested.
  • Perform in-service 'Console Transponder Calibration' tests using supplied hardware/software.
  • Setup consoles and monitor audio teleconferencing bridges for satellite news feeds.
  • Perform calibration tests on spectrum analyzers and other equipment used in the Service Assurance Center (SAC).
  • Coordinate customer additions and disconnects as directed by scheduled Service Orders.
  • Coordinate satellite transponder change requests as directed by Engineering.
  • Isolate and resolve satellite transponder interferences.
  • Perform certification tests for all new digital uplinkers.

Ground Station/Facilities Operations

  • Operate, configure and monitor ground station subsystems, including: Electric, Air Conditioning, Communications, IT;
  • Maintain and operate ground station equipment: Antennas, RF, IF, Communications, test equipment;
  • Record all significant customer activities or internal events in the station log;
  • Maintain and update facility site documentation;
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance;
  • Prepare Performance Analysis reports, as requested by engineering/management;
  • Develop, maintain and distribute daily reports, operational shift logs and trouble ticket database to appropriate individuals on a needed basis;
  • Prepare and distribute (E-mail) daily reports;
  • File completed logs;
  • Perform shipping, ordering, handling, inventory, and testing of on‑line and spare parts;
  • Monitor building, fire, and security systems.
  • Handle on-call, special and In-Charge assignments

Education and Experience required

  • Technical specialization (Certified Technician) on Telecommunications or Electronics.
  • Ability to write, read and speak on both English and Portuguese languages.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals;
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence;
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.
  • Decision making and Supervision:
  • Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action;
  • Receives instructions on new assignments or projects;
  • Actively seeks information and guidance to improve own performance.

Working Conditions

  • 12 x 36 (or similar) shift work
  • Working onsite in office
  • Occasional travel
  • Occasional visits to customer sites

description:
Descrição da vaga

Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.

Desafios estratégicos:

O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo.

Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio.

Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps.

Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário.

Atuação de Arquitetura:

A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução.

A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa.

title: Analista Segurança da Informação Senior CLT
description:
1. Gestão de Segurança da Informação

  • Realizar o levantamento de maturidade em Segurança da Informação com base na ISO 27001 e outras normas correlatas;
  • Elaborar, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos corporativos de segurança;
  • Coordenar e acompanhar planos de ação de segurança, assegurando aderência às normas internas e frameworks;
  • Conduzir análises de risco com base na ISO 31000, elaborando relatórios e priorizando medidas mitigatórias;
  • Apoiar a adequação à LGPD, incluindo análise de riscos de privacidade, revisão de contratos e avaliação de terceiros;
  • Apoiar processos de auditoria e certificação, respondendo evidências e implementando controles corretivos;
  • Desenvolver e aplicar campanhas de conscientização de segurança e boas práticas para usuários.

2. Atuação Técnica e Operacional em Infraestrutura e Segurança

  • Monitorar, investigar e tratar incidentes de segurança em conjunto com os times de infraestrutura, redes e sistemas;
  • Executar análises técnicas em servidores e estações para identificar vulnerabilidades, incidentes e não conformidades;
  • Aplicar medidas corretivas e preventivas diretamente nos ambientes sob gestão (patches, hardening, bloqueios, atualizações de segurança, etc.).
  • Apoiar a operação de ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, GLPI, SIEM, antivírus, firewall, etc.).
  • Gerenciar acessos, permissões e políticas de identidade (AD, MFA, IAM, PAM), garantindo conformidade com políticas corporativas;
  • Participar da implementação e validação de novas soluções de segurança e infraestrutura;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos com registro de ações corretivas e preventivas executadas.

3. Gestão de Vulnerabilidades e Continuidade

  • Conduzir scans e análises de vulnerabilidade com ferramentas como Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7 ou equivalentes;
  • Classificar e priorizar vulnerabilidades conforme criticidade, avaliando impacto e risco para o negócio;
  • Apoiar planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP e BCP);
  • Acompanhar planos de remediação, garantindo que as correções sejam aplicadas e documentadas.

4. Relacionamento e Governança

  • Atuar como interface técnica entre o cliente e as áreas internas da empresa;
  • Participar de reuniões operacionais e de governança, apresentando indicadores e status de segurança;
  • Apoiar o cliente em processos de compliance, auditorias e investigações internas;
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios executivos de segurança, com análise de riscos, incidentes e recomendações;
  • Conduzir workshops e treinamentos internos sobre segurança da informação e ciberdefesa.

title: Assembly And After-Sales Support Technician
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician

Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Reports to: Account Manager and CTO

Contract Type: CLT

About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.

Position Summary:

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Position duties and responsibilities:

  • Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
  • Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.

Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.

Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.

LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.

Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

  • Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician .
  • Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English .
  • Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
  • Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Atuar em equipe ágil no desenvolvimento e sustentação de produtos digitais, entregando valor de forma contínua e com qualidade, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a estabilidade das soluções em produção.

  • Garantir a segurança e a qualidade das entregas, respeitando os padrões estabelecidos pela equipe;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo ou cursando na área de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Programação orientada a objetos (POO);
  • Linguagem Java (preferencialmente versão 8 ou superior);
  • Spring Framework (Core, Boot, Data, etc.);
  • Criação de APIsRESTful;
  • Controle de versionamento com Git;
  • Arquitetura baseada em microsserviços.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Vivência com mensagerias (Kafka, RabbitMQ);
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Desenvolvimentoorientado a testes (TDD, BDD);
  • Criação de testes de integração e de carga;
  • Utilização de containers (Docker);
  • Orquestração com Kubernetes;
  • Banco de dados NoSQL (MongoDB);
  • Uso de cache (Redis);
  • Vivência com atuação em times ágeis e em ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

Se você se identifica com esses valores e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e que adora desafios, temos uma oportunidade como Supervisor de Terminal de Passageiros.

Missão do cargo: Você será responsável pela supervisão das equipes que atuam diretamente no Terminal de Passageiros do aeroporto, bem como a garantia da normalidade dos fluxos operacionais. 

Esse desafio requer que você desempenhe as seguintes atividades:

  • Elaborar relatórios diários com registros fotográficos, constando as principais ocorrências operacionais do seu turno;
  • Acompanhar, avaliar e notificar quando necessário, o serviço das empresas subcontratadas que atuam nos terminais, bem como companhias aéreas, assegurando a operacionalidade do aeroporto e mitigando os impactos nos Terminais;
  • Estabelecer linha de comunicação aberta e amigável com a comunidade aeroportuária e demais áreas do RIOgaleão, com foco no relacionamento com as companhias aéreas, disseminando o Espírito de Servir;
  • Multiplicar treinamentos alinhados com a área de P&O, dedicando-se sempre no desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional da sua equipe;
  • Promover reuniões periódicas com equipe de Agentes para garantir a qualidade da informação entre as equipes e áreas parceiras;
  • Realizar estudo diário de quantidade de passageiros por hora-pico e malha aérea, garantindo a boa alocação da equipe de acordo com a demanda de passageiros;
  • Garantir que as empresas aéreas estejam em linha com as metas/resultados acordados;
  • Buscar melhorias relacionadas a experiência do passageiro, incentivando sua equipe a apresentar contribuições.

Habilidades e qualificações necessárias:

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos no setor de aviação;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em liderança e gestão de equipes;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade para atuar sob pressão e cumprir prazos; 
  • AtitudesGATE do Integrante RIOgaleão Garra e Determinação, Autodesenvolvimento, Trabalho em Equipe e Espírito de Dono. 

Você sai na frente se:

  • Tiver ensino superior completo ou em andamento;
  • Possuir conhecimento em aeroporto; 
  • Inglês fluente.

-Gestão de Fornecedores: Supervisionar a performance de empreiteiras, fornecedores de mobiliário e equipamentos, garantindo qualidade, custo e entrega.

-Melhoria Contínua: Analisar indicadores de performance das inaugurações para propor melhorias nos processos internos, reduzindo o Time-to-Market e otimizando custos de implantação.

title: Analista de Governança
description:
Sobre nós:

A MDC tem como propósito fazer da energia sustentável uma geradora de valor.

Investimos em ativos energéticos com presença em toda a cadeia de gás natural, biometano, energia elétrica renovável e vapor através de biomassa. Oferecemos soluções energéticas para negócios que almejam uma economia de baixo carbono, proporcionando estabilidade e valor sustentável a longo prazo.

Conheça um pouco da nossa empresa em 

Queremos sempre fazer mais e melhor, com segurança e com pessoas engajadas que não desistem dos desafios. Chegamos até aqui com muito esforço e trabalho em equipe. Dedicamos nossa energia para desenvolver negócios sustentáveis. Agimos como donos e estimulamos a inovação.

Buscamos criar um ambiente inclusivo, justo, seguro e respeitoso para todos, onde cada colaborador tenha acesso às mesmas oportunidades de desenvolvimento. Em nossa Companhia, não aceitamos discriminação ou preconceito, sejam eles de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, raça, nacionalidade, condição física ou quaisquer outros. Valorizamos nossa gente, nossa diversidade, fortalecendo o time. Criamos espaços para autenticidade.

ANALISTA DE GOVERNANÇA

Prestar suporte às atividades de governança corporativa e rotinas societárias da Companhia, incluindo a organização de reuniões da Diretoria, Conselho de Administração e Assembleias, elaboração e controle de atas e documentos societários, gestão e controle de procurações, bem como a administração e atualização do portal e dos repositórios de documentos do departamento Jurídico.

  • Controlar o arquivamento físico e digital de documentos jurídicos e societários;

title: Comandante a330
description:
Não pode faltar em sua bagagem:


Formação


  • Ensino Médio completo (Ensino Superior é um diferencial)


Experiência


  • Experiência superior a 5 anos na função e na aeronave.


Certificações Obrigatórias


  • Licença de Piloto de Linha Aérea (PLA);
  • Certificado de Habilitação Técnica (CHT) para o Airbus A330;
  • Certificado Médico Aeronáutico (CMA) válido;
  • Passaporte brasileiro válido por mais de 6 (seis) meses;
  • Vistos americanos B1, B2 e D válidos.


Conhecimentos Técnicos


  • Regulamentação aeronáutica aplicável (RBAC 121 e CBA);
  • Sistema de Gerenciamento de Segurança Operacional (SGSO);
  • Procedimentos operacionais da aeronave A330;
  • Operação de aeronaves widebody e voos de longo curso.


Idiomas


  • Proficiência na língua inglesa (ICAO) 4 ou superior.


IMPORTANTE: o local de trabalho será definido após a aprovação no processo seletivo. É necessário possuir disponibilidade para mudança.

Missão do Cargo


Exercer a autoridade de Comandante desde a apresentação para o voo até a entrega da aeronave ao final da viagem, garantindo a Segurança operacional, a conformidade regulatória e a continuidade das operações e representando a empresa perante passageiros, tripulação e autoridades, em alinhamento ao Código Brasileiro de Aeronáutica (CBA) e aos regulamentos vigentes.


Além disso, atuar em integração com os Times da Companhia, contribuindo com sua experiência para o fortalecimento contínuo da operação.


Autoridade


  • Exercer autoridade plena sobre a aeronave, tripulação, passageiros e carga durante toda a operação;
  • Recusar aeronave que não esteja em condições aeronavegáveis;
  • Adiar, suspender ou encerrar o voo quando indispensável à Segurança;
  • Recusar embarque ou determinar desembarque de pessoas que comprometam a Segurança ou a disciplina a bordo;
  • Adotar medidas necessárias à proteção da aeronave, das pessoas e dos bens transportados;
  • Representar o Administrador da empresa durante toda a viagem;
  • Atuar em ocorrências relacionadas a atos ilícitos (AVSEC), mantendo comunicação com os órgãos de controle;
  • Contratar manutenção extraordinária, quando necessário;
  • Validar licenças e certificados, conforme prerrogativa da autoridade aeronáutica.



Segurança Operacional


  • Garantir a Segurança de tripulantes, passageiros e carga do fechamento das portas até o desembarque final;
  • Assegurar as condições de aeronavegabilidade, peso e balanceamento;
  • Certificar-se da correta quantidade de combustível e monitorar seu consumo;
  • Avaliar as condições meteorológicas, NOTAMs e dos aeródromos;
  • Garantir que o voo esteja devidamente despachado junto ao DOV.;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos do Programa de Segurança do Operador Aéreo;
  • Reportar condições inseguras aos órgãos de controle e à área de Safety;
  • Identificar e reportar perigos operacionais por meio do sistema oficial da empresa.


Gestão da Tripulação


  • Assegurar a subordinação técnica e disciplinar da tripulação;
  • Delegar atribuições, exceto aquelas relacionadas à Segurança do voo;
  • Definir o Pilot Flying e garantir a execução correta dos checklists;
  • Garantir que apenas atividades essenciais sejam realizadas em fases críticas do voo;
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da regulamentação profissional, incluindo jornada, repouso e limites operacionais.


Conformidade e Registros


  • Preencher ou assegurar o correto preenchimento do Diário de Bordo e do Relatório Técnico da Aeronave;
  • Registrar ocorrências que demandem inspeção obrigatória, como pouso duro, turbulência severa, tail strike, RTO, incidência de raio e excedentes de limites operacionais;
  • Assegurar os registros de ocorrências a bordo, incluindo eventos médicos, nascimentos e óbitos, conforme regulamentação aplicável;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de Segurança Operacional (SGSO) e da Política Ambiental.


Cabine e Passageiros


  • Assegurar a transmissão das instruções de Segurança;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de Segurança em situações normais, de emergência e em evacuação;
  • Assegurar a integridade e a Segurança da cabine de comando;
  • Garantir a correta utilização dos equipamentos de emergência.

title: Analista de dados - arquitetura
description:
Quem somos?

A Incentive.me é uma plataforma tecnológica de engajamento da força de vendas que permite alcançar um novo patamar na Gestão de Incentivos. Conectamos empresas a vendedores ao longo de toda a cadeia, até a ponta no varejo, criando campanhas de incentivo eficazes que transformam comportamentos e aumentam as vendas. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar uma cultura voltada para performance e resultados.

Objetivo da posição

Construir e manter a camada semântica oficial de dados da empresa, garantindo que métricas e relatórios consumidos por ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Metabase), produto (dashboards e relatórios internos e externos) e liderança executiva estejam baseados em uma definição única, consistente e orientada a negócio. A arquitetura deverá incluir uma camada semântica programável (ex: Cube.js) para servir métricas
de forma padronizada via API.

Principais responsabilidades

Definir métricas oficiais da empresa
Modelar entidades e regras de negócio na camada semântica
Implementar e manter Cube.js (ou ferramenta similar)
Garantir que diferentes consumidores usem as mesmas definições
Estruturar transformações no data warehouse
Garantir qualidade, rastreabilidade e consistência dos dados
Organizar versionamento de modelos e métricas
Trabalhar junto com Engenharia e Infra para garantir estabilidade
Disponibilizar métricas via API semântica
Preparar datasets para BI
Apoiar integração da camada semântica no produto
Realizar análises exploratórias
Identificar padrões e oportunidades
Experimentar aplicações de IA sobre dados estruturados
Apoiar decisões estratégicas com análises quantitativas

Requisitos técnicos:

SQL avançado
Experiência com data warehouse moderno
Experiência com modelagem de métricas e regras de negócio
Experiência com ferramentas de BI
Experiência ou forte interesse em Cube.js (ou camada semântica similar)
Experiência com transformação de dados (dbt ou similar é diferencial)

Diferenciais

Experiência como Analytics Engineer
Experiência integrando camada semântica ao produto
Experiência com dados financeiros ou de marketplace
Conhecimento em estatística aplicada
Experiência com experimentação ou IA aplicada a negócio

Perfil esperado

Capacidade de estruturar domínio novo do zero
Pensamento sistêmico
Forte senso de ownership
Clareza conceitual para transformar regra de negócio em métrica formal
Capacidade de equilibrar engenharia e análise

O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios adicionais: plano de saúde,plano odontológivo vale-refeição e auxílio home-office.

  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional.

Junte-se a nós e faça parte do Futuro do Incentivo!

  • Perfil empático, comunicativo, proativo e focado em resultados, com capacidade de se conectar facilmente com pessoas.

  • Remuneração competitiva, com fixo, comissionamento e bonificações por desempenho, com grande perspectiva de aumento e crescimento.

    Comissão por cada contrato: R$300
    Bônus: R$2000 (para 10 contratos)

Sobre a Vaga:

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Enfermeiros Visitadores apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um enfermeiro que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da enfermagem no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

title: Corretor de imóveis - região do rio de janeiro e proximidades.
description:
Descrição do Cargo

O Corretor de Imóveis será responsável por identificar, prospectar e negociar terrenos urbanos na Paraíba, com área mínima de 1.000 m² e ligação trifásica, para implantação de projetos de energia solar. Além da negociação, será responsável por realizar toda a tramitação documental e verificar a legitimidade das propriedades, garantindo a conformidade com as exigências legais e regulatórias.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Prospectar Terrenos: Identificar terrenos em áreas urbanas que atendam aos requisitos técnicos e estratégicos da empresa.
  • Negociação: Conduzir negociações com proprietários, visando condições favoráveis para a aquisição ou locação dos terrenos.
  • Análise Documental: Revisar e validar a documentação dos terrenos, assegurando a regularidade jurídica e cartorial.
  • Validação de Legitimidade: Verificar a titularidade, pendências legais e possíveis restrições ou ônus sobre as propriedades.
  • Relacionamento com Stakeholders: Manter contato com proprietários, cartórios e órgãos reguladores para assegurar a conclusão dos processos de compra ou locação.
  • Relatórios e Acompanhamento: Elaborar relatórios de prospecção e status dos processos para a equipe de gestão.
Requisitos Impreteríveis
  • Registro ativo no CRECI (Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis).
  • Experiência comprovada em prospecção e negociação de imóveis urbanos.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.
  • Conhecimentos sobre processos de regularização fundiária e análise de documentos imobiliários.
  • Habilidade em negociação e comunicação interpessoal.
  • Familiaridade com a região da Paraíba, especialmente com áreas urbanas estratégicas para projetos de energia solar.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência em projetos relacionados à energia solar ou infraestrutura elétrica.
  • Conhecimento sobre regulamentações de ligação trifásica e requisitos técnicos para projetos de energia.
Condições de Trabalho
  • Modelo de Contratação: PJ ou CLT, a ser negociado.
  • Remuneração: Base fixa + comissão por contrato fechado.
  • Benefícios: Reembolso de despesas de deslocamento e possíveis bônus por desempenho.

Experiência com ferramentas de CRM, especialmente HubSpot.
